Chapter 517: Chapter 14 Black Tower Second Layer (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 517: Chapter 14 Black Tower Second Layer (Please Subscribe)

Space Rules, one of the pillars that the universe relies on for its operation.

What are pillar rules? Without Space Rules, the universe would become imperfect or even collapse.

All existence, all things, must rely on space—it is the foundation of everything.

Having fully mastered Space Rules, even if just one aspect, Lin Yuan’s perception of the outside world has drastically changed.

Before grasping Space Rules, Lin Yuan was like a fish in water, limited to its immediate surroundings; but after mastering Space Rules,

it was as though he leapt out of the water, able to see more, to look further.

...

“Space Rules, perhaps not as mystical as the Rule of Time, which can reverse the flow and resurrect the dead, but its permeation into all things is much deeper.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Only now has he fully reached the Ninth Rank, without mastering Space Rules, even if his combat power surpassed the threshold of the Ninth Rank.

Fighting against another Ninth Rank powerhouse, they could come and go as they pleased, using their manipulation of space to ‘toy with’ Lin Yuan at higher levels.

Like a whale living at the bottom of the ocean, despite its immense strength, it cannot threaten the life on land.

“Mastering space is just the beginning; next, I must fuse the Taiji Rule with many cosmic forces with the Complete Space Rules, to carve my own path.”

Excitement swelled within Lin Yuan; the path of the Ninth Rank was almost at hand, only the final integration of the Fusion Rules was needed to step into the Ninth Rank.

In the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, the Ninth Rank truly represents a profound existence; many weak and ordinary clans’ most powerful ancestors are only at this level.

“My Inner World?”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended into his Inner World, only to discover that his once billion-mile Inner World had once again started to expand greatly.

Fortunately, Lin Yuan had anticipated this and took out the Tai Micro Clear Crystal he had prepared in advance, merging it into his Inner World.

The sound of rushing water.

It wasn’t long before.

The Inner World expanded to a size of 1.31 billion miles in diameter.

The dense World Force operated, where ordinary Eighth Layer invincibles would be crushed in the presence of such a vast World Force, unable to even resist.

“With the current support of my Inner World, fully absorbing the green liquid from the Mysterious Gourd should pose no difficulty.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, having attempted to absorb the green liquid in recent years, but always stuck at the final hurdle, now likely to easily cross it.

“First, absorb the green liquid.”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness returned to the outside world, took out the gray-green gourd, tipped it upside down, and began the absorption.

…

Thousands of light-years from the B0001 Exotic Battlefield.

A black space vessel finished its Wormhole Shuttle and revealed itself.

“That’s the B0001 Exotic Battlefield?” Lin Yuan, inside the space vessel, looked towards the massive object thousands of light-years away.

The B0001 Exotic Battlefield, the first Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield established by human civilization, spans about twelve light-years.

Powerful Eighth Layer invincibles can also fight to their hearts’ content on this battlefield, without the need to hold back.

“Forget it, I’ll just use the Great Transference Skill for the remaining journey.”

Lin Yuan stepped out of the space vessel, having grasped Complete Space Rules, even a simple Great Transference Skill could span hundreds of light-years without any ‘cool-down time’—much more efficient than the vessel’s Wormhole Shuttle.

Of course, using Great Transference to travel consumes a lot of energy, so if not in a hurry, it’s better to travel via ship and Wormhole Shuttle.

Lin Yuan decided to use the Great Transference Skill to travel, as he was only a few thousand light-years away and wanted to experience the sensation of using the skill for travel.

Whoosh.

Edge of the B0001 Battlefield.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, looking at the battlefield ahead.

“The spatial fluctuations are significant, far richer than those on the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield where the Taiyin Primordial Spirit is located…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The spatial fluctuations on the Otherworldly Battlefield arise from the constant battles of countless strong beings, as well as the presence of Permanent Spatial Rifts.

As the oldest of the Otherworldly Battlefields,

in the distant past, the intensity of the battles often escalated,

with Tenth Rank Evolvers wielding Supreme Weapons personally entering the fray,

and tearing open Permanent Spatial Rifts wider and longer than those on other Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields.

The spatial rifts on ordinary Small-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields are about ten meters to several tens of meters wide, while those on Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields generally exceed ten thousand meters, ranging from ten thousand to twenty thousand meters.

And the largest Permanent Spatial Rift on the B0001 Battlefield reaches thirty thousand meters.

This is not an ordinary rift but a Permanent Spatial Rift, an ‘injury’ that even the inherent motion of the universe cannot heal.

“Let’s check out that thirty-thousand-meter long Permanent Spatial Rift first.”

Lin Yuan suppressed his aura and moved towards the target location. While on an Otherworldly Battlefield with obvious spatial fluctuations, it’s best not to use the Great Transference Skill, even if one has mastered Complete Space Rules.

Because it’s easy to be affected by the fluctuating space, leading to deviation from the destination, or even a temporary loss amidst the depths of numerous spatial layers.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, with the green flames inside his body burning wildly, before settling back down to tranquility.

“Finally completed the absorption.”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended once more into his Inner World, and gazing at the quietly expanded 1.332 billion mile vast realm, his face showed satisfaction.

Normally, human Evolvers who have mastered Complete Space Rules have an Inner World limit of ten million miles in diameter, while those special beings with peak bloodlines, like the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun or other unique spatial entities, have an upper limit of several tens of millions of miles.
